result.summary: Found 1 issue: the circular button in the top-right header shows only an empty grey circle with a red notification dot, so its icon or avatar appears to have failed to render. The rest of the page (search bar, category chips, promo banner, carousels, restaurant cards, bottom navigation) renders as expected.

issues.description: The circular button at the top right of the header is an empty light-grey circle with only a small red badge dot. The icon or avatar it should contain (e.g. notification bell or profile image) is missing, so the button's purpose is unclear.
issues.suggestion: Make sure the icon or avatar asset loads and renders inside the button. Add a fallback glyph (e.g. bell icon or user initials) for when the image fails, and check that the icon colour does not match the button background.
